hedgehog_roller.name: Shinobi
hedgehog_roller.description: Fast, cheap melee fighter. Dashes to the nearest building.

frog_lobber.name: Kunai Adept
frog_lobber.description: Throws kunai from a distance. Fragile, so keep it behind sturdier warriors.

beetle_brute.name: Armored Guardian
beetle_brute.description: A heavily armored frontliner who marches straight for defenses and soaks up their fire.

owl_bomber.name: Kite Raider
owl_bomber.description: Glides over walls on a war kite and drops firebombs on defenses. Sky Bow Towers and Shuriken Towers can hit it.

mole_digger.name: Tunnel Runner
mole_digger.description: Digs under walls to reach any building.

saboteur.name: Saboteur
saboteur.description: Grapples over walls to the nearest working defense and jams it for 6 seconds. One jam per Saboteur; afterwards it fights weakly. A jammed defense can't be jammed again until 10 seconds after it recovers.

twin_fang_dancer.name: Twin-Fang Dancer
twin_fang_dancer.description: Every hit lands twice, on its target and the next building beside it.

wind_step_assassin.name: Wind-Step Assassin
wind_step_assassin.description: Dashes to a new target; the first hit after each dash deals double damage.

moonblade_master.name: Moonblade Master
moonblade_master.description: Every fourth strike is a crescent slash for 2.5x damage.

storm_sovereign.name: Storm Sovereign
storm_sovereign.description: Slashes arc between up to three nearby buildings.

shuriken_storm.name: Shuriken Storm
shuriken_storm.description: Throws three shuriken at once; small splash.

blowgun_hunter.name: Blowgun Hunter
blowgun_hunter.description: Darts keep damaging a building for 5 seconds.

chain_sickle_reaper.name: Chain-Sickle Reaper
chain_sickle_reaper.description: Hits make the target take 20% more damage from everyone.

thousand_needle.name: Thousand Needle
thousand_needle.description: Long range (5 tiles) and rapid fire; must stay behind cover.

iron_monk.name: Iron Monk
iron_monk.description: Warriors beside him take 15% less damage.

bell_warden.name: Bell Warden
bell_warden.description: Rings a bell that makes defenses in range target him first.

mountain_shield.name: Mountain Shield
mountain_shield.description: Carries a tower shield that absorbs splash for allies behind him.

oni_breaker.name: Oni Breaker
oni_breaker.description: Huge health; smashes walls for five times damage.

trap_breaker.name: Trap Breaker
trap_breaker.description: Finds and disarms hidden traps along the squad's path.

gearbreaker.name: Gearbreaker
gearbreaker.description: Two jams per warrior, each lasting 9 seconds.

fuse_master.name: Fuse Master
fuse_master.description: Plants a charge on a defense that explodes after 5 seconds.

ghost_engineer.name: Ghost Engineer
ghost_engineer.description: Once per battle, jams up to three defenses within 3 tiles for 4 seconds. Shares jam immunity with other specialists.

wall_climber.name: Wall Climber
wall_climber.description: Climbs over walls and goes for storehouses first.

grapple_raider.name: Grapple Raider
grapple_raider.description: Swings over walls straight to the nearest defense.

mole_king.name: Burrow Ambusher
mole_king.description: Bursts out of the ground beside a defense, stunning it for 2 seconds.

phantom_gate.name: Wall Phantom
phantom_gate.description: Walls near it crumble, opening a path for everyone.

crane_glider.name: Crane Glider
crane_glider.description: Very fast flyer that raids storehouses.

lantern_balloon.name: Lantern Balloon
lantern_balloon.description: Slow balloon that drops burning embers in a wide area.

thunder_kite.name: Thunder Kite
thunder_kite.description: Lightning hits a defense and up to three nearby defenses for 35% damage each.

dragon_kite_armada.name: Dragon Kite Crew
dragon_kite_armada.description: A heavy dragon kite carrying a crew of bombers.

drum_monk.name: Drum Monk
drum_monk.description: Nearby warriors move and attack 25% faster within 3 tiles. Multiple drums do not stack.

mist_weaver.name: Mist Weaver
mist_weaver.description: Wraps nearby warriors in thin mist (a small moving smoke cloud).

spirit_caller.name: Spirit Caller
spirit_caller.description: Brings one fallen warrior back to its feet.

sage_of_clouds.name: Sage of Clouds
sage_of_clouds.description: Once per battle, heals nearby warriors for 25% and grants a 4-second, one-hit shield (blocks up to half their maximum health). Shields cannot be refreshed for 10 seconds.

ram_crew.name: Ram Crew
ram_crew.description: Four times damage against walls and gates.

fire_monk.name: Fire Monk
fire_monk.description: Short-range fire that burns a small area of buildings.

bomb_carrier.name: Bomb Carrier
bomb_carrier.description: Runs to the nearest wall or defense and explodes.

siege_bombardier.name: Siege Bombardier
siege_bombardier.description: Artillery with 5-tile range that fires on defenses. Stops to fire every 2.5 seconds; still inside a Cannon's reach, and a Longbow Yagura hunts it.

volcano_cannoneer.name: Volcano Cannoneer
volcano_cannoneer.description: Huge splash that leaves burning ground.

hound_handler.name: Hound Handler
hound_handler.description: Fights alongside two hunting dogs. The handler and dogs share one health and damage budget.

hawk_tamer.name: Hawk Tamer
hawk_tamer.description: Her hawk harries a defense from range, slowing its fire.

boar_rider.name: Boar Rider
boar_rider.description: Charges through the first wall in its way.

bear_warrior.name: Bear Warrior
bear_warrior.description: Hits much harder below half health.

tiger_lord.name: Tiger Lord
tiger_lord.description: Arrives with two war tigers. Rider and tigers share one health and damage budget.

shadow_stalker.name: Shadow Stalker
shadow_stalker.description: Cannot be targeted until it attacks for the first time.

mirage_twin.name: Mirage Twin
mirage_twin.description: Leaves a decoy that draws fire for 4 seconds.

night_blade.name: Night Blade
night_blade.description: Deals double damage to buildings inside smoke.

void_walker.name: Void Walker
void_walker.description: Steps through shadows straight onto its target.

eclipse_ninja.name: Eclipse Ninja
eclipse_ninja.description: Unseen until its first attack, immune to traps, and has a 25% chance of double damage on each hit.
